expectations.text: Report identifies that the root defect is at write time (signup stores email as-typed).
expectations.evidence: The root cause is placed in the lookup, not the write path. Headline line 3: 'The root cause is in the user store, not in search. `db.find_by_email` compares emails as exact strings'. Root cause row (line 77): 'The store defines email identity as exact equality ... Lookup and uniqueness both inherit that definition.' Why 3 (line 58) does say 'Signup stores the email exactly as the customer typed it', but the report treats as-typed storage as intended: Assumption 3 (line 110-112) keeps the display email as typed and 'avoids a data migration'. The insert duplicate guard is a write-time uniqueness fix, not a write-time normalization. Borderline, judged false under the same bar as with_skill/run-3.
